text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks for the kind words. That 
turned out to be some really great 
real-race practice, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the grand stage made them afraid 
of making mistakes. The other runners' 
strategies showed a different trend than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Let's refine the theory based on this 
from now on. Would you accompany me on the 
walk home right away? First, regarding the 
starting gate..."

And so, on the way back from the 
racetrack, I ended up listening to her 
theories on and on—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, have we arrived already? That went 
by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, once a plan has been put together 
this far, it's only natural to want to put 
it to the test, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it looks like... we still 
have some time before dorm curfew.
choice_data_list: Just a little bit, got it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I appreciate your cooperation.

And so, when Biwa Hayahide and I headed 
toward the training track...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't go worrying over nothing. I 
can still run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race too, didn't you? 
She was strong. It made me wanna win. 
That's exactly why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Those guys making a fuss ever since then, 
saying stuff like "It's a one-horse 
Classic" and "She has no rivals"... piss 
me off...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that until you've actually seen 
me run!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait up--!! Taishin--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna snap both of you into 
shaaaaape!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH-------!! HAAAAAAAAAA-------!!

"As one accelerates, the other surges 
back. The breathless battle between the 
two continues—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...What magnificent legs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ticket's sheer tenacity to squeeze out 
every last bit of energy. And Taishin's 
terrifyingly fierce late charge."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both possess top-tier finishing bursts. As 
expected... of those two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And also... I'm sorry, Trainer-kun. It's 
rich coming from me after I brought it up, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we can save tonight's practical test 
of theory for another time. If I'm 
around... well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I have nothing but gratitude for you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As for our future plans—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I should proceed along the Classic Triple 
Crown route. That is what I believe.

"The Classic Triple Crown route is the 
path leading from the 'Satsuki Sho', to 
the 'Japanese Derby', and finally the 
'Kikuka Sho'."

And each one, just like the Nippon Derby, 
is a once-in-a-lifetime stage for an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to complete the formula for victory 
and stand at the pinnacle of this 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, facing off against that 
one-of-a-kind Umamusume ...Brian, would be 
an utter impossibility.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I believe that facing Ticket 
and Taishin is something that "must not be 
avoided."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Do you agree with this path?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad. I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I will surely become an Umamusume who 
stands at the pinnacle. One who will not 
lose to them, or to anyone else."

And so, Biwa Hayahide and I set our next 
goal as the Satsuki Sho, the first race in 
the Classic Triple Crown series.
